title: Large-Scale Virtual Screening Prioritizes Candidate Allosteric Modulators of TIMP2: Computational Identification and Structural Characterization of a Cryptic Binding Site
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦TIMP2蛋白的别构小分子虚拟筛选与隐蔽口袋鉴定，属于蛋白质-配体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及转录因子或核酸结合，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Background: Tissue Inhibitor of Metalloproteinase-2 (TIMP2) has emerged as a critical regulator of synaptic plasticity and cognitive function through its role in extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. Recent evidence suggests that enhancing TIMP2 function, rather than inhibiting it, may offer therapeutic benefits for cognitive enhancement and neuroplasticity. However, TIMP2 has historically been considered "undruggable" due to its protein-protein interaction mechanism and lack of traditional binding pockets. Methods: We performed a large-scale virtual screening campaign using a CNS-filtered subset of the ZINC20 database. Starting from ~1 billion molecules, we applied strict CNS drug-likeness filters (MW: 250-430 Da, TPSA ≤70 Å², HBD ≤1, cLogP: 2.0-3.5), resulting in 13.6 million candidates distributed across 136 chunks. Using AutoDock Vina with an adaptive parallelization strategy, we screened six strategically selected representative chunks totaling ~600,000 molecules against TIMP2 (PDB: 1BR9), targeting both canonical and potential cryptic binding sites. Results: Virtual screening of six completed chunks (~600,000 molecules) identified a cryptic allosteric site involving residues Val6, Leu100, and Phe103 in TIMP2's N-terminal domain. From ~11,500 compounds meeting initial CNS and PAINS criteria, comprehensive ADMET profiling using ADMET-AI v2.1 revealed only 178 compounds (1.5%) achieving Tier 1 safety classification. Orthogonal toxicity validation using ProTox-III further refined this set to 154 highest-confidence candidates (Tier 1A, 86.5%), with 22 compounds (12.4%) requiring enhanced monitoring due to borderline acute toxicity (Tier 1B) and 2 compounds (1.1%) deprioritized due to extreme LD50 predictions (Tier 1C). Chunk-level survival rates varied dramatically from 0.3% (strict_0055) to 9.3% (strict_0028), with strict_0028 yielding the majority (52%) of all Tier 1 compounds. Notably, while halogenation is common (41.6% of Tier 1 compounds), it is not universal, with strict_0028 demonstrating that non-halogenated compounds can also achieve favorable ADMET profiles. The best overall compound (ZINC000870248439_1, -9.0 kcal/mol from strict_0120) and the largest chemical family (93 compounds from strict_0028, including both chlorinated and non-halogenated scaffolds) demonstrated excellent CNS penetration (BBB >0.9) and clean safety profiles. Conclusions : This work represents the first systematic computational prioritization of candidate small-molecule TIMP2 modulators and reveals a previously uncharacterized cryptic binding site that accommodates diverse chemical scaffolds. Integration of ADMET-AI and ProTox-III predictions enabled refined risk stratification, yielding 154 highest-confidence candidates validated across orthogonal computational toxicology platforms. The dramatic variation in ADMET survival rates across chunks (0.3-9.3%) highlights the importance of broad chemical space sampling. While halogenation enhances certain drug-like properties, our results demonstrate that both halogenated and non-halogenated compounds can achieve the demanding intersection of high affinity, CNS penetration, and drug safety. Structural validation using the AlphaFold v6 predicted structure confirmed the cryptic allosteric pocket with sub-angstrom accuracy (mean Cα deviation = 0.30 Å, triad pLDDT > 96), and cross-species conservation analysis revealed 100% pocket identity in mouse TIMP2, the primary translational model. Molecular dynamics simulation (100 ns apo) confirmed pocket stability under physiological conditions with 94% area preservation, sub-angstrom per-residue fluctuations (triad RMSF = 0.84 Å), and convergence of triad distances to within 0.14-0.43 Å of crystallographic values. Ligand-bound MD of seven representative compounds revealed compound-specific binding behavior ranging from complete dissociation (<7 ns) to persistent pocket occupancy over 100 ns. Two structurally distinct benzamide compounds maintained >96% heavy-atom contact over 100 ns: ZINC000583127796 (304 Da, spirocyclic thiolane, 98.7% contact, Phe103-anchored binding with pocket opening to 36.4 Å²) and ZINC001228612316 (268 Da, cyclopropane, 96.7% contact, balanced triad engagement with crystal-geometry preservation at 31.2 Å²). Across all seven compounds, persistent binding tracked with a primary benzamide that anchors at Phe103 plus a compact, conformationally restricted appendage rather than any single ring type: the two persistent binders carried different rings (a five-membered thiolane and a three-membered cyclopropane), and a benzamide compound bearing a larger, more flexible six-membered thioether dissociated. Ensemble re-docking across nine apo MD conformations spanning the 100 ns trajectory indicated that Site 1 remains ligand-compatible, with the lead accepted in every conformation, arguing against a single-conformation artifact. These results demonstrate that the cryptic pocket supports stable small-molecule binding through more than one persistent binding mode and point to a preliminary pharmacophore hypothesis—benzamide-mediated Phe103 anchoring together with geometric constraint in the appendage—for experimental optimization. These findings support TIMP2 as a potentially tractable drug target and provide 154 computationally validated chemical starting points across diverse scaffolds for experimental follow-up.
abstract_zh: 背景：金属蛋白酶-2组织抑制剂（Tissue Inhibitor of Metalloproteinase-2, TIMP2）通过其在细胞外基质（extracellular matrix, ECM）重塑中的作用，已成为突触可塑性和认知功能的关键调控因子。近期证据表明，增强TIMP2功能而非抑制其功能，可能为认知增强和神经可塑性提供治疗益处。然而，由于TIMP2的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用机制及缺乏传统结合口袋，其历来被视为“不可成药”（undruggable）靶点。方法：我们使用ZINC20数据库的CNS过滤子集进行了大规模虚拟筛选。从约10亿个分子出发，我们应用严格的CNS类药物特性过滤器（分子量：250-430 Da，TPSA ≤70 Å²，HBD ≤1，cLogP：2.0-3.5），得到136个块（chunks）中分布的1360万个候选分子。使用AutoDock Vina配合自适应并行化策略，我们筛选了六个策略性选择的代表性块，总计约60万个分子，针对TIMP2（PDB：1BR9），靶向经典和潜在隐蔽结合位点。结果：对六个已完成块（约60万个分子）的虚拟筛选，在TIMP2的N端结构域中识别出一个隐蔽变构位点，涉及残基Val6、Leu100和Phe103。从满足初始CNS和PAINS标准的约11,500个化合物中，使用ADMET-AI v2.1进行的全面ADMET分析显示，仅178个化合物（1.5%）达到Tier 1安全分类。使用ProTox-III进行的正交毒性验证进一步将该集合精炼至154个最高置信度候选物（Tier 1A，86.5%），其中22个化合物（12.4%）因边缘急性毒性需要加强监测（Tier 1B），2个化合物（1.1%）因极端LD50预测而被降级（Tier 1C）。块级存活率从0.3%（strict_0055）到9.3%（strict_0028）差异显著，其中strict_0028贡献了所有Tier 1化合物的大多数（52%）。值得注意的是，虽然卤化是常见的（Tier 1化合物的41.6%），但并非普遍存在，strict_0028证明非卤化化合物也能获得有利的ADMET特征。最佳整体化合物（ZINC000870248439_1，-9.0 kcal/mol，来自strict_0120）和最大的化学家族（来自strict_0028的93个化合物，包括氯化和非卤化骨架）表现出优异的中枢神经系统穿透性（BBB >0.9）和清洁的安全特征。结论：本研究代表了对候选小分子TIMP2调节剂的首次系统性计算优先级排序，并揭示了一个先前未表征的隐蔽结合位点，该位点可容纳多样化的化学骨架。ADMET-AI和ProTox-III预测的整合实现了精细的风险分层，产生154个在正交计算毒理学平台上验证的最高置信度候选物。各块间ADMET存活率的显著差异（0.3-9.3%）强调了广泛化学空间采样的重要性。虽然卤化增强了某些类药物特性，但我们的结果表明，卤化和非卤化化合物均可达到高亲和力、CNS穿透性和药物安全性的严格交集。使用AlphaFold v6预测结构进行的结构验证确认了隐蔽变构口袋，精度达亚埃级（平均Cα偏差 = 0.30 Å，三联体pLDDT > 96），跨物种保守性分析显示，主要转化模型小鼠TIMP2中口袋一致性为100%。分子动力学模拟（100 ns apo）确认了生理条件下口袋的稳定性，面积保留率为94%，每残基波动为亚埃级（三联体RMSF = 0.84 Å），三联体距离收敛至晶体学值的0.14-0.43 Å范围内。七个代表性化合物的配体结合MD揭示了化合物特异性结合行为，范围从完全解离（<7 ns）到100 ns内持续口袋占据。两个结构不同的苯甲酰胺化合物在100 ns内维持>96%的重原子接触：ZINC000583127796（304 Da，螺环硫杂环戊烷，98.7%接触，Phe103锚定结合，口袋开放至36.4 Å²）和ZINC001228612316（268 Da，环丙烷，96.7%接触，三联体平衡参与，晶体几何保持于31.2 Å²）。在所有七个化合物中，持续结合与锚定于Phe103的伯苯甲酰胺及紧凑、构象受限的附属基团相关，而非任何单一环类型：两个持续结合剂携带不同环（五元硫杂环戊烷和三元环丙烷），而带有更大、更灵活的六元硫醚的苯甲酰胺化合物则发生解离。跨越100 ns轨迹的九个apo MD构象的集成重对接表明，位点1保持配体兼容性，先导化合物在每个构象中均被接受，这排除了单一构象伪影的可能性。这些结果表明，隐蔽口袋通过不止一种持续结合模式支持稳定的小分子结合，并为实验优化提出了初步药效团假说——苯甲酰胺介导的Phe103锚定结合附属基团的几何约束。这些发现支持TIMP2作为潜在可成药靶点，并提供154个跨多样化骨架的计算验证化学起点，供实验后续研究使用。
